item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that an ASK press conference described Bangladesh's human-rights situation as dire, while also listing an assessment that the Awami League's 2018 election manifesto had not fully implemented many commitments and a major share-market scandal involving alleged embezzlement of 158 crore taka.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","4B.2","4B.3","5B.5","7B.9","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Events and reporting dated January 2023; relevant to the 2023 period but some claims concern prior commitments and ongoing investigations.","ruler_attribution":"The items concern the government and ruling party, but do not directly establish Sheikh Hasina's personal participation in each alleged abuse or financial offense.","limitations":["The archive supplies headlines and metadata rather than full articles or underlying evidence.","Several entries report allegations, opinions, or third-party assessments without adjudicating their accuracy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":22,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"The archive records an Election Commission-related evaluation difficulty concerning an EVM project, reports that 4 lakh driving licences were stuck, and reports that road accidents had killed 9,951 people over eight years.","question_ids":["3B.6","4B.1","4B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports dated January 2023; the licence backlog and accident figures describe institutional conditions extending beyond 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are institutional-performance reports and do not by themselves prove a direct order or decision by Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The archive does not provide the underlying Commission evaluation, licence-administration records, or accident methodology.","The long-period accident total is not a 2023-only outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":121,"end_unit":123,"fact_summary":"The archive reports criticism that bureaucratic orders curtailed the Anti-Corruption Commission's powers, alongside a nationwide backlog of about 42 lakh pending cases and delays in highly publicized trials.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","5B.5","7B.6","7B.7","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reports dated January 2023 and describing active institutional conditions during the period.","ruler_attribution":"The reports concern state institutions under the government but do not identify Sheikh Hasina as the direct author of the alleged curtailment or delays.","limitations":["Only headlines and classification metadata are supplied.","The archive does not state whether any reform or corrective action followed."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":166,"end_unit":167,"fact_summary":"At the government's four-year anniversary, Sheikh Hasina reportedly urged the public not to tolerate obstruction of the constitutional process; the archive also records an external assessment that Bangladesh's development had been weakened by governance deficits.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.8","4B.10","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Both items are dated January 2023 and directly fit the 2023 political period.","ruler_attribution":"The constitutional-process statement is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the governance-deficit assessment is an external report or commentary.","limitations":["The archive does not provide the full speech or specify the alleged governance failures.","A stated commitment to constitutional process is not evidence of implementation by itself."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":374,"end_unit":375,"fact_summary":"A civil-society webinar reportedly characterized the Digital Security Act as having established a climate of fear, while a government hospital report described planning and coordination deficiencies.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","6B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reports dated January 2023 and relevant to powers and service administration operating during the period.","ruler_attribution":"The items concern laws and government administration associated with the government, but do not establish Sheikh Hasina's personal intent or direct operational role.","limitations":["The supplied material is a headline-level record of a webinar and report.","No text is provided on enforcement practice, subsequent correction, or the hospital's specific failures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":492,"end_unit":493,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that the National Curriculum and Textbook Board acknowledged errors in textbooks and that commentary described the Dhaka metro rail as implementation of the prime minister's vision.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","8B.1","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports dated January 2023; the textbook correction is a contemporaneous administrative response, while metro-rail implementation reflects a longer project timeline.","ruler_attribution":"The metro-rail item attributes the project to Sheikh Hasina's vision in commentary; the textbook acknowledgment is attributed to NCTB rather than directly to her.","limitations":["The archive does not specify the scale of textbook errors or the corrective process.","The metro-rail entry is an opinion/commentary item rather than an independent project evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1154,"end_unit":1156,"fact_summary":"The archive reports publication of the Universal Pension Act 2023 and separately records a Road Safety Foundation finding that rural-road crashes disproportionately killed children.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","5B.3","6B.2","6B.3","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Items dated February 2023; the Act is a 2023 institutional measure, while the road-safety finding indicates an unresolved exposure during the period.","ruler_attribution":"The pension law is a parliamentary/government measure associated with the administration; the road-safety finding does not attribute responsibility directly to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["No enrollment, funding, uptake, or implementation data for the pension system are supplied.","The road-safety entry gives no detailed causal analysis or government response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1472,"end_unit":1478,"fact_summary":"During March 2023, the archive records Sheikh Hasina calling on the UN Secretary-General and the UN to take effective steps to stop the Russia-Ukraine war.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.8","1B.10","2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated March 2023 and within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The calls for diplomatic action are explicitly attributed to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The items show public diplomatic advocacy, not implementation of a peace agreement or measurable effect on the war.","No evidence is supplied about Bangladesh's military, financial, or other material involvement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":1774,"end_unit":1775,"fact_summary":"The archive reports Sheikh Hasina inaugurating a submarine base and stating that the armed forces were being developed with increased capability; a separate SDG seminar urged faster action toward water and sanitation goals.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.5","1B.7","2B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports dated March 2023 and directly within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The submarine-base inauguration and capability statement are attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the SDG recommendation is from seminar participants.","limitations":["The material does not specify the base's mission, budget, safeguards, or whether capability increased coercive risk.","The SDG item does not establish adoption or implementation by the government."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2490,"end_unit":2494,"fact_summary":"The archive reports foreign-exchange reserves of about $30.36 billion, but also records a budget direction from Sheikh Hasina and related reporting that public spending faced major economic pressure and that the proposed budget prioritized stabilizing the economy.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.9","5B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports dated May 2023 and directly relevant to the 2023 fiscal period.","ruler_attribution":"The budget direction is attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the reserve figure and economic-pressure assessments are attributed to financial reporting and commentators.","limitations":["The archive does not provide the complete budget, execution data, or reserve methodology.","The entries do not establish whether the measures improved distributional outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2524,"end_unit":2528,"fact_summary":"Before and during Cyclone Mocha in May 2023, Sheikh Hasina reportedly said preparations had been completed and monitored the response throughout the day; the archive also records a formal disaster-management response and disruption of examinations in affected areas.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","3B.10","6B.6","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated May 2023 and within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"Preparedness and monitoring statements are explicitly attributed to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The archive does not provide casualty, evacuation, shelter, resource-allocation, or comparative outcome data.","Monitoring and preparedness claims are not independently verified in the supplied text."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":2878,"end_unit":2881,"fact_summary":"In June 2023, Sheikh Hasina told parliament that government measures had restrained essential-commodity price increases and directed that officials avoid business-class foreign travel at public expense; the same archive section reports a budget with expanded social-security allocations.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","6B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly dated June 2023 and within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The price-control claim and travel directive are attributed to Sheikh Hasina; the social-security allocation is a budgetary measure associated with the government.","limitations":["The archive does not provide price-series evidence demonstrating the claimed effect.","No execution, targeting, or beneficiary-incidence data are supplied for the social-security allocation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7f0b30434080fd7a","start_unit":3030,"end_unit":3033,"fact_summary":"The archive reports that 7,001 cases had been filed under the Digital Security Act and that inflation reached 9.94 percent, while parliament was told that the government had incurred large liabilities to state-linked entities.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","7B.1","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reports dated June 2023 and directly within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The figures concern laws and macroeconomic conditions under Sheikh Hasina's government but do not establish her personal responsibility for each case or liability.","limitations":["The archive does not identify the cases' outcomes, defendants, or legal basis.","The inflation and liability figures are reported without the underlying datasets or causal attribution."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["Only one supplied source was provided: the Bangladesh Parliament Library e-Clipping 2023 archive.","The supplied archive consists primarily of headlines, categories, and dates; full article text, sourcing details, and adjudication of allegations are generally unavailable.","Facts are limited to concrete, materially relevant items that can be stated without scoring or inferring unsupported personal responsibility."]}
